description: This Java servlet handles the clearing of shopping cart items by removing the 'cartItems' attribute from the user's session and redirecting to the ViewCart page.

classes.name: ClearCartProducts
classes.description: A servlet that clears the user's shopping cart stored in session and redirects to the cart view.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to clear shopping cart items from session and redirects to ViewCart.
